systems.name: Wed→Fri iron condor
systems.subtitle: ±0.8% shorts, wings 1% beyond each short

evidence.how:
434 real campaigns priced on NSE bhavcopy closes, untraded contracts excluded. Restated to 10 lots — the study ran 2 lots; size is a multiplier, not evidence, so both sides scale together.
research/143 settled why this disagrees with the original Calmar 1.63. On 334 campaigns matched day-for-day — same anchor, same period, same strikes, same rule — the old engine says +₹1,029/campaign and real prices say −₹328. The whole gap is pricing: that engine had no volatility skew, so it underpriced the long wings. Every rule difference was measured separately and is worth under ₹100: the ×2 stop ₹6 (it never fired in 545 campaigns), the Wed→Fri vs Fri→Mon anchor ₹64, the period ₹8.
evidence.caveat:
The original +₹880/campaign came from a no-skew simulation; on real prices it is −₹193. The book’s 7 winning cycles sit 1.45 standard errors from that — luck, not counter-evidence.
Sized to 10 lots on 3 Sep 2026 at Arun’s instruction. The seven closed cycles above were recorded at 2 lots and are restated ×5 at the same fills — scaled, not re-simulated. Paper only.

does: Built to use the days the 9:16 books leave idle — in Wednesday, out Friday, flat before Monday so it never competes for margin.
SELL a strangle ~0.8% OTM either side; BUY each wing 1.0% beyond its own short (≈250-pt verticals).
Friday close. Never carried over a weekend.
The backtested spec closes if the combined premium doubles.
10 lots = qty 650 since 3 Sep 2026 (2 lots before).
doesnt: The running book has no stop code at all — only the wings cap it. A known divergence from the tested spec.
Never held into Monday or Tuesday.
Refuted 31 Aug 2026 on 434 real campaigns: −₹193/campaign at t −1.30 (−₹965 at the new size).
It never stopped running. The row said “Stopped” because that label was hand-written after the refutation while the job kept trading — corrected 3 Sep 2026.
